steps.name: Hello, Inspiration (1)
steps.objective: Report the quest to [Liz] at the “Belfar Library.”

steps.name: Hello, inspiration (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Liz] in “Belfar Library” and report the quest to [Leef] in “Riftrasir”.

lines.text: (A gap in time, the exact time of which is unknown.)

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: (Mutt)

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Come to your senses.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Uh… … .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I was so entranced.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: (slap)

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Ouch, it hurts!!

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Are you out of your mind?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Liz, tell me about that book.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Last time, while I was taking a rest, I received a wave of bad magic coming from the empty sea, right?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: That's right... .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: A librarian who is sensitive to magic like you must always be alert. Otherwise, you will be consumed by bad energy.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Sorry. I didn't do that on purpose.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: So this will be difficult for you. If you enter the playground, the worst might happen.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I already asked for help, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: To whom? Uh, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. Pell, Liz.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Uh, uh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Tiger too... I remember saying that if you do it, it will come.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Was this a word used a lot in Elias? Ugh.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Seeing that Adventurer came like this, it seems that Heffling delivered the letter properly. Ugh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was surprised when Heffring suddenly came with a letter.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Fel scouted the Heffling that flew to the playground. “Heffling, you seem to have talent. Would you like to work together?” Like this.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I provided him with snacks for three meals a day, and I also took out pet insurance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's nice. But what did you call me for?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Inspiration is gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's Hermit, the spirit that the Belf librarians call old man, he's here... .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Not that old man. “Inspiration.” For those with magical powers, it is a spiritual sensation, but it usually refers to a flash of ingenious thought or stimulation that comes to mind when creating.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . Can I help you find that “inspiration”?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Of course. You've already solved the world-ending crisis several times.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Fel, I would like to explain [Playground of Inspiration] to %s. I'll be blocking toy cars and airplanes from coming in here.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Yeah. Please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A playground of inspiration? Is it a playground in the library?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Leda, the god of knowledge, loved children very much and wanted to teach them many things.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: So when we established the library, we created a lot of space for children. One of them is a playground.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Children love it because there are lots of toys and rides. Many adults also visit here because they say looking out into the empty ocean relieves their suffocating feelings.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: In particular, it was said that writers and artists get a lot of inspiration, so at some point it came to be called a [playground of inspiration].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why is it so noisy now?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Someone's great inspiration remained in the playground and became embedded in the toys and rides.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Plus, creating something like a large golem is a pain in the ass. ha… .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: If they get in, it will all be a mess. It's already so hard to organize books every day!!

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: No, if it gets mixed up with the knowledge inside, it could be a big problem... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happens?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: The flow of knowledge that sustains the world stops and becomes polluted. People will start believing the wrong things to be true.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: But for now, it's okay because the librarians are blocking it as much as possible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go and take down the golem.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Ah, Adventurer. As soon as I go there, inspiration comes rushing in. So, you need to know the owner of inspiration and prepare properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fel, do you know anything about the master of inspiration?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: This is Clara, a famous writer. We held an autograph session at the library not long ago, and after it was over, the playground looked like this. But I don't know where you are now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I met him at Liftrasir. I'll ask Director Leaf.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Really? Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Then I will come back quickly.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Whoa. Tire Man and the minicars are so persistent. I don't even know what they're saying.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Liz, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: You should be able to last a few days. But what about Adventurer?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Clara went to see the author.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I hope I find a way quickly... . Uh, what is this book? Author Clara’s signed copy?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Yes, new book. This is volume 1 of 『The Returned Queen of the Ruined Country Doesn't Hide That She's a Witch』. Did you see it too?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: This was distributed to all participants at the autograph event... . Who left it behind? Give it to me. I will find the owner.
「To. Kaina Dawn Sylvaria. Be happy.”

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Uh… Your Majesty has come... … ?

steps.name: Hello, inspiration (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Leaf] in “Rifthrasir” and go to [Clara] in “Crystal Moon Forest.” After the conversation, return to “Belfar Library” and report the quest to [Liz].

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Director.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Ah, %s. Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What were you doing?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I had some work to do in town and was worried. Oh, you know Clara, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It just so happened….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I know.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Clara held a signing event to commemorate the release of her new book at the Belfar Library. I thought it ended well, but for some reason I felt listless.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: So, when I asked about it, I was sitting at the playground for a moment and thinking about my next project, and the kids thought I had fainted and woke me up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fainted?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I thought I closed my eyes for a moment... Several hours had passed. So I left the library and returned to the village... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: After that, I couldn't think of anything I had planned for my next project. They even said that the next part of the manuscript being written will not be written.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Even if I force myself to sit down and write, my hands won't move at all.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Just in case, I looked around Clara to see if there were any malicious spirits, but there weren't any... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, you know something, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Leaf briefly about the situation at Belfar Library.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Ha, something like that happened. Clara doesn’t even know that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it okay if I go and meet him?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It'll be okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where is Clara?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I went for a walk in the Crystal Moon Forest. It's always in the same place, so you'll be able to find it quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll talk to Clara and find a solution.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Please take care of our Clara.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Normally, he would keep recommending something related to Liftrasir, but he didn't do that today.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe, I'm not an evil director who just says things like that.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You'll be busy, so go see Clara quickly. I will give you the Riftrasir promotional ambassador appointment letter later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll tell you about promotional ambassadors later when I feel like it. Then goodbye.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Yes, bye.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Is the library director away? You should be able to suppress that much in one go... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I haven't been able to write a single line for days. I've never had anything like this... . I feel like a fool.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: The goblin is crying. Kobold is Kobol Kobol... . Ah, I didn't mean to write something like this... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Clara.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: … hi. long time no see.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I'm going to go here again... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not it... . excuse me…

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I have some work to do so please excuse me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Clara, wait a minute. You went to Belfar Library not long ago, right?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I went to the playground of inspiration... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Clara about the situation at Belfar Library.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: My inspiration is running wild there? That sounds a bit strange... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Inspiration is something that comes and goes and stays again and again. If something comes to mind and you don't write it down, it will just disappear.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: If you don't express it, it doesn't exist... . It's ridiculous that it came out and caused such an incident.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's crazy, but it actually happened. If you don't handle it properly... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: What else is there... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explain to Clara the worst-case scenario Fel had described.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I have no magic power, and I can't see spirits... .
(At that time, something falls from the tree standing next to Clara.)
Boom!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I'm surprised... .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, see you again. %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I ended up here after chasing a scoop. Hmm, this woman smells.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: … It's rude to stink, chick.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: It's not a chick, it's a parrot. And isn't that what a smell is, Clara?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: do you know me

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hehehe, of course. Identifying celebrities is also a journalist's skill.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: You heard it all... ? Are you going to write this as an article?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: It's definitely a scoop, but Daniel, I won't write an article without permission from the person involved. Still, I have a headline in mind. Would you like to hear it?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: “Enjoy binge reading at the famous author’s library, shocked!”

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Yeah, I hate it. I will refuse.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Couldn't this be modified? “Famous best-selling author, ruined due to lack of inspiration.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's all because you learned how to make titles from someone?
(Daniel takes out a book from his bag and holds it up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Rosengarten Monthly… . If you write an article exactly as it appears there, you will be really ruined.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s, please help me. You can't dig up dirt every day!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Demigod Lydia said that if you want to eat something delicious, write a proper article and come back!!
(As Daniel flutters, something falls from the monthly Rosengarten he was holding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what is this?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, I never thought this would be here. This is sticky paper that catches invisible things, like ghosts.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s, since you said you've been to Rosengarten, I'm sure you've seen them. You know the soul that looks like a plastic bag, right?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: If you leave them alone, they float around, so I glued them together with this and collected them. This is more precious because only I can use it... .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: That too is a memory... . Ah, Rosengarten disappeared... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: %s, wait a minute. Quiet. Could it be possible to catch the running spirit with that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's a good idea. Shall we try it?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: That chick over there, no, the parrot, you said it was Daniel, right?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I'll help you write an article, so let's go report the scene together.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Okay, thank you. Parrot reporter Daniel Ga, I was thrilled!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Ah, here's the scoop! As expected, the smell of the scoop was not wrong... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: %s, let’s go to the library and get some inspiration with that sticky paper… … … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … The line is a little weird, but let's go ahead and try it.

steps.name: Hello, inspiration (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Liz] in “Belfar Library” and defeat monsters in “Zisk Territory” to obtain 5 <Zisk Blueberries>. Then report the quest to [Daniel] at the “Belfar Library.”

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: So that's what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: That's interesting, by the way. If the lower-level demons have even the slightest bad intentions... .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: As soon as he came in here, he must have screamed in pain.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: He is looking around the library with sparkling eyes. A parrot reporter looking for a scoop, so cute.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: They say they had permission from Demigod Lydia, so it must be okay.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: If it's not okay, I'll handle it.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: That's one shot, right?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I guess I'll have to try that... .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Well, what should I do if you say such scary words so openly?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Don't be too scared. Just don't do bad things.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: For an item from the demon world, it doesn't seem to have any bad energy.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: The parrot housekeepers worked hard all night without receiving minimum hourly wage or overtime pay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh my... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Reporter Daniel.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Nem?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: When I conclude this on-site coverage, I will also do an interview about the new book.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I understand! Please take care of me!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Please take care of your role as a string parrot.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I understand! yes? String parrot?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: It's nothing... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pell, Liz. Which way should I go to get to the playground?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Just go straight forward from the downstairs hallway. uh?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: What's wrong, Liz?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I think the movement of the rides and toys in the playground has become more active since the author came.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: But reporter, my stomach keeps growling.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: It's because I haven't eaten anything except dirt for several days... . Radish… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then I'll share some of my food with you. Is this okay?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: As expected, %s, you are the best!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Parrot… . No, parrot reporter Daniel eats human food… ?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I can't eat it because I don't have it! I really don't have any... . Black.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: %s. There is a sticky paper that reporter Daniel is holding here. I didn't think one piece would work, so I made several. Take it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, Fel.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, we'll go back as soon as Daniel finishes eating.

steps.name: Hello, Inspiration (5)
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Daniel] in the “Belfar Library” and enter the “Playground of Inspiration.” 
2.  After defeating [Tire Man of Inspiration] and settling the situation in “Playground of Inspiration,” go outside and report the quest to [Daniel].

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Huaaa, it was a good meal! Now I feel like I can do my best to report!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Give me some sticky paper. If you do this... .
(Clara collects sticky papers and sticks them all over Daniel’s body.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Ready... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, can I come in now?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh! A scoop awaits. Here's a scoop!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: It'll be okay because the hero is there just in case.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Daniel, are you a hero? or not… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you talking about me?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Aren't you a warrior? You've solved many dangerous problems. That's why I just called it that.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Come on, let's go. The warrior catches the young man running wild, and the reporter catches the old man with a piece of string.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: What does the author do?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Wait and see.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, wait and see. great… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I was going to escort you, so don't worry too much. I'm going in now, so you two need to follow behind me.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: But what does wait-and-see mean? Are you saying we're ruined?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I just meant to watch. It's not ruined.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Wait-and-see, wait-and-see. I knew it was really going to fail.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the playground of inspiration… .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Wow, is this a playground of inspiration? There are lots of toys and rides.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The empty sea is clearly visible from here. Thanks to the wide open scenery, I feel like my stuffy stomach has been relieved.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Sometimes, when I come to Belfar Library, I look out into the empty ocean from here. Sometimes good material comes to mind.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Huh? I hear a strange sound... .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Ugh… . Toy airplanes, toy horses, mini cars, and even slides are coming!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, calm down.
(The cardboard airplane hovering over Clara’s head stops.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Are you my inspiration?
(The cardboard airplane that stopped at Clara's words passes the group and is about to fly outside the playground.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: %s, grab that.
(%s's attack causes the cardboard plane to crumple and fall to the floor.)
Kuek.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Huh? The plane made a loud noise and dropped something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I can't see it... .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I attached it to a sticky stick! Do you see this?!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: It looks like a shiny bead... where… .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh, the marble is gone.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: … This definitely sounds like my inspiration. I remembered a part of the manuscript I was writing that I was stuck on... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: What is it about?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: The hero, the hero, dies after being hit by a coachman's carriage while he was driving drowsily.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: But the goddess appears and says it is not time to die yet, and gives me a chance to live again... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: When I opened my eyes, I found myself a demon with tremendous power. Moreover, he kidnapped the princess and was on his way to the demon world.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Isn’t it the devil who does things like kidnapping princesses?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Next... .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Mu, mu!! Writer, hurry up, next time!! Mu, mu!!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: … I lost inspiration and can't remember the last part... . I need to find more inspiration in the playground.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I will find all those inspirations. No, I'll put a lot of it all over my body!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can grab it and Daniel can bring it back.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: %s, I feel strange. I feel sick... . Now I just found a little inspiration... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You won't suddenly faint like last time, right?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Sorry, I don't know... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then please wait outside.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s, inspiration awaits you soon! I have to finish it quickly!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, it’s dangerous to go alone. Let's go together!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Heh, heh. I put a lot of beads of inspiration on it and my body feels heavy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, hold on just a little longer.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: For the story behind the author’s manuscript… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn’t the scoop interview first?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oops! Scoop, scoop first!
Wow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s, where are you acting so cute?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wasn't trying to act cute, but I heard a strange noise... .
Woooooo!
(A strange sound is heard and a huge shadow appears in front of Daniel and %s.)
Boom!
Wow!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Avoid it, Daniel!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hehehe, I survived thanks to %s. What is flying now? tire… radish?
Wow!
(A monster made entirely of tires appears with a cute scream.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: He calls himself the tire man of inspiration! Let me listen to you for a moment.

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Wow! Wow! Wow!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: This body was just hanging out in the corner with nothing to do just because it was a waste tire! However, I woke up with tremendous inspiration and magical power!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Now you will conquer the playground and establish a Thai kingdom! And I will play with my kids!
(The inspirational tire man nods his head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I believe that... .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I don't think there are any lies.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Daniel, how do you understand what the tire man is saying?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: When I was unemployed in the demon world, I acquired level 2 of the Monster Language Proficiency Test (MLPT) to prepare for employment.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Level 2 is also quite helpful in reporting. There are a lot of noblemen in the demon world who don't communicate well... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What kind of place is the Demon World?)

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Wow! Wow! Wow!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like it has become more threatening... . Daniel, what does the tire man say?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Leave your inspiration and go away!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: For an amusement ride to have a cute face and use such bad words, I can't forgive it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is Daniel going to do?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s, please punish that tire man right now!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, as expected… .

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Wow! Wow!!
(As the Tire Man waves his arms, a strong wind blows around him.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Noisy parrot, fly higher than Freios?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Am I going to fly away?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oh my gosh, I flew! I can’t fly. Muuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu… … … … … … … … … … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel? Daniel!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It flew so far away that it became a star in the sky... .

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Wow! Wow! Kkkkkkkkkk!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you saying? no way… .

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Wow! Wow! Kkkkkkkkkkkkkkk!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can’t you just turn it off? I think it's like this.

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if you don’t like it?

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Woooooo! Wow!
(Tire Man's roar resonates so loudly that it fills the air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, tire man. Maybe I shouldn't leave it like that, but that noise is annoying to my ears.

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Wow!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Tire Man. Be prepared to lose your wind!!

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow! No, take it!
(Tire Man is pushed back by %s's attack.)

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Wow... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't see any signs of falling down.
Wow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Byung? What is this sound?

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The sound of wind falling from somewhere... ?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: When I pull out the flag on the tire man's head, the wind goes out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel? Didn't it fly away?

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: What? What?! Wow!
(The tire man was so embarrassed that the air started to go out and he couldn't come to his senses.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hehe, seeing how the wind goes out so easily, you're not a tire man, you're a tube man!

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Wow! Wow!
(The tire man desperately tries to block the hole with his arms, but it's not enough.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s, finished! Just finish it! It's not me, it's the tire man!
(At Daniel’s words, Adventurer gathers his strength and strikes the tire man.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Wow, %s. Best sibnidam. This big idiot was made from a waste tire!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoa, it's over.

lines.speaker: 영감의 타이어맨
lines.text: Wow... .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I guess Tire Man is of a similar type. Wow... And I dropped the bead of inspiration.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've attached the beads to Daniel's body, so it's over now.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Phew, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how did you come back? It was blown away by the wind earlier.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: It flew away fluttering.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Didn't you say earlier that you couldn't do it?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Since none of the parrots had ever flown, I had no idea that I too could fly.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: My arms are a little numb. Ugh. Don't touch it! I got a cramp!! Ughhhhh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Daniel.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: In that case, articles related to %s are exclusively written by me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, shall we go?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Interview... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aren't you going?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Wow, scoop… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a joke. Don't do it now, do it later. I promise.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Wow, you promised! If you do it, the goddess will scold you! Ugh, did you touch my hand again?!

steps.name: Hello, inspiration (6)
steps.objective: Talk to [Daniel] and [Pel] at the “Belfar Library” and report the quest to [Pell] at the “Belfar Library”.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Author Clara, your inspiration has returned!
(Daniel shakes his whole body in front of Clara and shakes off the beads of inspiration.)

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Why are there so many... .
(Every time Clara touches the sparkling bead, it makes a clear and beautiful sound and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Clara, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I feel like a child who ran away from home has returned. Did my mom feel like this when I ran away from home?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Mom would have understood! So, so what happens next?!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I won't tell you because it's a spoiler.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Writer, this is worse than giving delicious food and then taking it away! There are demons worse than me... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Daniel, will you give me the magazine or newspaper with the article if I ask for it? Shouldn't you pay the right price? They say they live by digging in the dirt... .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hehehehe, I don’t want to dig up the dirt… . I want to eat something delicious. Mooooooo.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Daniel, you're not a bad demon.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Oops, demons. It's not that demon. This is a talking parrot. I follow your words well.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Now to say no... . Well, that's enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Thank you all.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I found all my inspiration, and now I feel like I can write without any problems.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: So… Let's interview.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Have you been deceived?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: … Yes, I was deceived in the demon world. There was also employment fraud... .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I am dumbfounded because everyone here is trying to take care of me.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: There are bad people in the world, but there are also good people... . So do you want to do an interview or not?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Author, may I interview you now?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Yeah. Do it quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, while I interview you two, I will tell the librarians that the playground issue has been resolved.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Wow! Interview story, interview! radish! radish! Author, I have a question for you now!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Since when did a girl named Clara have a knack for writing? And when did you first realize that you wanted to publish a book? and… .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: When was that... About four or five years old? From then on… … .

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I’m glad author Clara found all the inspiration… .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: As I was shouting for inspiration so much, Old Hermit came rushing in, which was a big problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could this happen again in the future?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I can't guarantee it, but it's not entirely possible.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: There may be other people who are full of inspiration other than author Clara, but we will watch more carefully to prevent something like this from happening... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you need my help, please contact me next time.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Just your words are reassuring.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: This is a small, but small Ellie.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Please accept it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s okay… .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: If you just leave, the director will scold you. I heard you called someone who is already busy.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: … Liz, I don’t want to get scolded… .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Calm down, Fel. Actually, I don’t like being scolded either… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. I'll be grateful.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Thank goodness… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How can these two get scolded by the director?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The interview took longer than I expected.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: If you are busy, you can go back first. If you have something to say to author Clara, I will pass it on to you.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: We also have something to say to the author.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? I have nothing to say in particular. Oh, please tell me I hope your manuscript turns out well. And see you later.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Yes, that's what I'll say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then goodbye.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Please return carefully.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: … When will the director come?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Well… .

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Ah, here comes the writer.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Librarian, is the room I used before empty?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Yes. It's empty.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Because of Daniel, we had some good material, so we canned it together… .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Canned food, canned food! What kind of food is it? (Twinkle)

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh, I guess that's not the canned food the author is talking about.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Then what is it?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Something that does not come out or cannot come out until the manuscript is completed is called canned… .

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Am I canned too?

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Yes, canned food.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: He is level 2 in the Monster Language Proficiency Test, so he can communicate with the rampaging tire man, and judging by his writing of articles, he seems like a great talent... . Do you want to work for me?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Monster Language Proficiency Test Level 2?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: It's amazing. That would have helped resolve the playground issue. Please do our work for us later.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hmm… . I am a reporter... . I just like eating canned food... .

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: We'll provide lodging, meals, snacks, and a reduced salary... .
(Clara whispers the salary amount into Daniel's ear.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: … I think I could make a living at that level even without looking for scoops!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Still, I need your help so I can write a scoop article later!

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: 클라라
lines.text: Librarian, can I ask you a favor like you did before?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Canned food, canned food! delicacy!!
(In the end, Daniel enters the studio with Clara, singing the canned song.)
(I heard it later, but it is said that he was not able to leave the library until long after the new work was completed.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Black, black. I was fooled again... .
